| --- | --- |
| Original classes inventoried | 21 |

## Input provenance and refresh

Target: `dah1-j2me-en-v1.2.0`. Original SHA-256:

`2e03916ea4a5260960e5e57e4dbe0778fb9b577439eac0ce94a685cfecdaaf5f`

The inventory was checked against a local hash-verified structural audit. The original JAR, assets, disassembly, and recovered game source are not included in this map.

```console
python tools/source_map.py
```

With a locally generated audit, also use `python tools/source_map.py --check --audit local/audit-source-map.json`. New tracked files need manifest entries. See the maintenance guide for staging order and evidence rules.
